game.name: Kinect Star Wars (Japan, Europe)
game.desc: Kinect Star Wars on Xbox 360 is an action game using the Kinect peripheral. The software offers 5 distinct game modes: the main one allows you to follow a young padawan in a scripted campaign and the others offer pod races, destruction sequences in the skin of a rancor, galactic dance sessions and duels against emblematic characters of the saga. A co-op mode for two is also included.
